title: Sebata, Kill, Kill, Co. Kildare
description:
*EMAIL REPLIES ONLY WITH ALL RELEVANT INFORMATION* UNFURNISHED* Property Partners O'Brien Swaine are delighted to offer Sebata for rent, a truly exceptional five-bedroom detached residence set on approximately 0.33 acres of beautifully landscaped and meticulously maintained gardens in the heart of Kill Village. Extending to an impressive approximately 435 sq. metres, Sebata is a substantial and beautifully appointed home offering an exceptional standard of accommodation throughout. Built circa 2006, the property has been designed with a strong emphasis on quality, space and comfort, with excellent finishes, generous room proportions and an abundance of natural light. 

The accommodation is particularly impressive and includes a welcoming entrance hall, sitting room, large open-plan kitchen/living/dining room, tv room, utility room, guest WC and garage at ground floor level. Upstairs there are five spacious double bedrooms, four of which benefit from their own ensuite and dressing room/walk-in wardrobe, together with a main bathroom. The large open-plan kitchen/living/dining area forms the heart of the home and is ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. French doors provide direct access to the extensive rear garden and patio areas. 

Outside, Sebata is equally impressive. The property is approached through electric gates with granite walls and bespoke railings and provides ample off-street parking for up to eight cars. The large private rear garden is beautifully landscaped and not overlooked, with an extensive lawn, cobblestone patio areas and a wonderful selection of mature trees, shrubs and specimen planting including silver birch, copper beech, yew, Japanese maple, magnolia, hydrangea and Nordic spruce. A large cobblestone patio with an attractive granite sphere water feature provides a superb outdoor entertaining area. Additional features include a garden room suitable for year-round use, metal shed, bike shed and a delightful two-room wooden playhouse. 

Sebata enjoys an excellent location in the centre of Kill Village, allowing residents to enjoy village life while remaining within easy reach of Dublin and the surrounding areas. Kill offers an excellent range of local amenities including shops, cafes, pubs, restaurants, playground, GAA club and primary school, all within a few minutes' walk. Naas is approximately 10 minutes away and offers an extensive selection of shops, restaurants, schools, leisure facilities, theatre, cinema and hospital. Naas and Punchestown Racecourses are also within easy reach, together with Naas and Palmerstown Golf Clubs, Naas Rugby Club and a range of other sporting and leisure facilities. For commuters, the property is approximately three minutes from Junction 7 of the N7/M7, providing convenient access to Dublin and the wider motorway network. Sallins Train Station is approximately 10 minutes away, while the Citywest Luas is approximately 15 minutes by car. The 126 bus service to Dublin and Kildare also stops directly in Kill Village. 

Features include: 
• Exceptional five-bedroom detached home 
• Being let unfurnished 
• Approximately 435 sq. metres 
• Set on approximately 0.33 acres 
• Five large double bedrooms 
• Four ensuite bedrooms with dressing rooms/walk-in wardrobes 
• Large open-plan kitchen/living/dining room 
• Separate sitting room and family room 
• Family bathroom and guest WC 
• Utility room 
• Garage 
• Built circa 2006 
• Silver granite exterior with granite quoins 
• Gas-fired central heating 
• New Smart boiler fitted in 2025 
• Underfloor heating at ground floor level 
• Pellet stove in main living area 
• Internorm alu-clad windows and French doors 
• Oak internal doors 
• Brushed stainless steel sockets and switches throughout
 • Excellent insulation 
• Security cameras and alarm system
 • Electric entrance gates 
• Parking for up to eight cars 
• Large private rear garden which is not overlooked 
• Extensive cobblestone patio areas 
• Garden room 
• Metal shed and bike shed
 • Two-room wooden playhouse
 • Beautiful mature landscaping
 • Excellent central Kill Village location 
• Easy access to N7/M7 
• Approximately 10 minutes to Naas 
• Convenient access to Sallins Train Station, Luas and bus services Sebata represents a rare opportunity to rent a substantial and beautifully presented home offering exceptional space, privacy and quality in one of County Kildare's most convenient village locations.
